properties.method_note:
Union City publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (July 2019, Heyer Gruel &
Associates; ordinance 223-35). There is no municipal GIS layer to download,
so this script constructs one from official, citable sources:
properties.limitations: P-A air rights, redevelopment districts (8th St, D-BG, D-RS-A/B/S, D-ST, D-Y) and HPOD/PPOD overlays are not digitized; corner lots addressed on side streets resolve to R.
